body:
Scoped integration-owner approval — Slice 1a only (2026-10-10)

Independent Sol review of the existing `docs/design/deployment-revisions-draft.md` (SHA-256 `ee847c8eef8ebb55dbc1aea12956b5ab4522f4b61ada190ab0fe573d66e620dd`) establishes a dependency-ready implementation slice for pure canonical values and typed identity/reference parsing. The broader draft remains unaccepted. This is not approval of a Deployment resolver, database migration, API, artifact grant, adapter payload or Package compiler.

Approved boundaries:
1. `actions-canonical-json/v1`: strict raw UTF-8 JSON; reject duplicate raw keys, invalid Unicode/lone surrogates, nonfinite values, overflow and nonzero underflow; normalize strings/keys to NFC and reject normalization-created duplicates; serialize with exactly `rfc8785==0.1.4`. Preserve array order. No owner-specific object digest preimages.
2. Reject exact integral numeric values outside ±9007199254740991 regardless of spelling (`9007199254740993`, `.0`, and `e0` forms all reject). Ordinary fractional values use finite binary64 semantics. Direct RFC-library vectors and the restricted domain-input rules are separate contracts.
3. Canonical lowercase hyphenated UUID strings; exact `sha256:<64 lowercase hex>`; distinct immutable digest types; strict, frozen, extra-forbid reference models. Scope comparison requires explicit expected Workspace/package context. Valid syntax establishes neither object existence nor authorization.
4. Implement the draft's scoped package/deployment/provider/worker/policy revision references. `RuntimePlanRef` has one owning nested `PackageRevisionRef` and its typed plan digest. Keep #130's existing camelCase/readable-ID fixture schema experimental and unchanged; do not infer registry support or authoritative adapter payloads.
5. Defer command/idempotency digest calculation, replay, default Workspace creation, DB/API/resolver and dynamic admission. Slice 3 still requires Workspace-global idempotency scope, changed-input conflict and reauthorization before replay.

Paths: `action_server/src/actions/server/deployments/{__init__,ids,canonical}.py`, focused `test_deployment_canonical_values.py`, fixed golden vectors and configured dependency/lock adoption. Required proof includes adversarial parser/numeric/reference negatives, exact canonical bytes, fresh-process equality and explicit cross-scope rejection; no RCC/provider/DB access in pure parsing. Independent review and hosted checks are required before integration. The #134 RCC-first consumer and full #129/#130/#83 contracts remain open.
